soundness_flags.label: Definitions def:chart-graph, def:synchronized-pilot, and def:wedge-spectral-procedure; consequently Theorem 3
soundness_flags.one_line: The chart construction is not a total algorithm as written: the displayed vertical stack transposes factors with generally unequal column counts, qf/polar have no rank-deficient-event fallback, the pilot says only to “combine” overlapping chart factors, and the final radius invokes undeclared \(\mathscr R_n\).

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives an entrywise Gaussian approximation, Proposition 1 gives an entrywise interval, and Theorem 2 is a genie-aided Cramer--Rao/local-minimax lower bound for one missing entry.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work studies Gaussian-design trace regression, nuclear/Frobenius detection boundaries, and the obstruction to rank-adaptive honest nuclear confidence sets.
The paper uses factors from a tall block and re-rotated loadings from a wide block for missing-panel imputation and derives counterfactual/ATT asymptotics.
The paper advertises prescribed-coverage confidence intervals for individual treatment effects and more general bilinear functionals under staggered adoption.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the certificate total: correct the overlap-factor stack dimensions, specify deterministic aggregation for multiply represented pilot factors, declare \(\mathscr R_n\), and give qf/polar null-event fallbacks before retaining the polynomial-time and honesty claims.

Add a worked two-cohort or three-cohort common-anchor numerical-symbolic instance that computes the transport, derivative, covariance, and radius from observed primitives; this would make the construction independently auditable.

Strengthen the general-wedge OEQ into a stated graph-dependent alternative: either construct an unanchored transport with an explicit graph-amplification rate or formulate a matching packing lower bound parameterized by a named graph functional.

recommended_next_step: Revise the ill-defined synchronized certificate construction, then retain the field-tier global-nuclear-radius angle for Stage 0.
